thread:
emily: tossing an idea out — "quiet handoff" for region rollouts to minimize user-visible latency bumps and avoid accidental residency violations. want a short protocol we can standardize.
raj: +1. high level: prewarm caches -> gradual traffic bias -> hold -> commit or rollback. We need clear hysteresis windows.
tom: propose phases with durations: PREWARM(0-90s), RAMP(90-600s, linear 10%->70%), HOLD(600-1800s), COMMIT. Operators can abort anytime.
emily: rollback triggers? p95 > sla + 40ms sustained for 2m, 5xx_rate > 2x baseline for 1m, remote-kv-miss-rate > 3x.
sasha: add model-variant compatibility check. if tokenizers mismatch, deny route. catalog must mark compatible_variants.
legal: residency note: tenants with residency=strict must never be routed cross-region. For tenants with grace>0 we allow short cross-region routing but require explicit consent and an audit event.
data-protect: KMS constraint: never transfer envelope keys. For transient cross-region decrypts, use KMS-proxy-issued transient token with TTL <= grace_seconds and log key usage.
raj: sample per-tenant policy: 
```n{
  "residency":"eu",
  "cross_ok":true,
  "grace_seconds":"600",
  "audit_on_cross":true
}
```
(emitted as example only).
ops-bot: runbook stub created: /runbooks/quiet-handoff -> steps: prewarm, monitor, ramp, hold, commit, rollback and CLI snippets.
infra-bot: starting canary: quiet-handoff-v1 -> group=region-eu-slice-A -> bias=10% -> prewarm in progress.
tom: router state machine sketch: LOCAL_PREFERRED -> IN_GRACE -> GLOBAL_PREFERRED -> ROLLBACK. require metric stability window W (configurable). pseudocode: 
```nif tenant.locked: route_local()
else if phase == PREWARM: prewarm_caches(tenant)
else if phase == RAMP and metrics_ok: route_weighted(local=weight)
else if metrics_bad: trigger_rollback()
```
raj: also add cost guard for prefetch so we don't blow budget priming huge KV sets. tag prewarm work to tenant for billing.
sasha: prefetch heuristic: top-100 keys per tenant, warm model KV via low-rate synthetic prompts sampled from top prompts. backoff if latency on prewarm nodes rises.
legal: confirm audit schema must include tenant_id, tenant_residency, cross_ok_flag, timestamp, reason. we'll provide exact fields but approve general approach.
data-protect: add requirement to redact PII in audit payloads and store audit in EU for EU tenants.
emily: ops control: rollout CLI should accept --stagger and --cohort so we never flip all regions at once. prefer region-group staggers.
ops-bot: added CLI examples to runbook.
infra-bot: canary telemetry: p95 unchanged, remote-kv-miss-rate = 1.1x baseline, no 5xx spikes. scaling prewarm to next cohort.
emily: next actions: raj -> RFC PR with phases + config schema + sample policies; tom -> router state transitions + unit tests; sasha -> prefetch script and cost guard; data-protect -> KMS transient token flow doc; legal -> finalize audit fields. target RFC by end of week.
raj: opening PR today.
emily: thanks — if any telemetry trips, ops-bot please page oncall. :wave:
